nodes.label: Design System First Workflow
nodes.rationale: Always start with --design-system to search 5 domains in parallel and apply ui-reasoning.csv rules before detailed domain searches; hierarchical MASTER.md plus page overrides keep a global source of truth with page-specific deviations.

nodes.label: Master + Overrides Pattern
nodes.rationale: Persist design-system/MASTER.md as global truth; page files under design-system/pages/ override Master when present so sessions retrieve hierarchical rules.

nodes.label: Priority-Based Rule Categories
nodes.rationale: Accessibility and Touch rank CRITICAL; Performance and Layout HIGH; Typography/Color, Animation, Style MEDIUM; Charts LOW — so reviews focus highest-impact UX first.
